big_case.notes: Single question asking the Court to overrule Libretti and extend Apprendi/Southern Union jury findings to criminal forfeiture: real nationwide reach across federal forfeiture practice if taken, and it drew a response request plus two amicus briefs. But it is a specialised sentencing-procedure question with no circuit split, arising on an unpublished summary order, and it was denied without any noted writing after a single post-response conference.
